objective: Certificar en solo lectura el estado final global MPRO despues de completar secuencialmente 130QRO y ORIGEN full-history. Validar por sucursal 0021 y 0023 que COUNT, MIN y MAX de CENTRAL2020.dbo.Comanda_Corte coincidan exactamente con dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja, que no existan duplicados por ServerID+FolioCorte, que ambas unidades tengan cobertura completa y que Production no sea tocada. No realizar mutaciones.

queries.name: mpro_global_source_target_by_branch
queries.sql: SELECT src.sucursal,src.total_source,src.min_source,src.max_source,tgt.total_target,tgt.min_target,tgt.max_target FROM (SELECT Sc_Cve_Sucursal AS sucursal,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_source,MIN(Cc_Fecha) AS min_source,MAX(Cc_Fecha) AS max_source FROM CENTRAL2020.dbo.Comanda_Corte WHERE Sc_Cve_Sucursal IN ('0021','0023') AND (Es_Cve_Estado IS NULL OR Es_Cve_Estado<>'BAJA') GROUP BY Sc_Cve_Sucursal) src LEFT JOIN (SELECT SucursalOrigenID AS sucursal,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_target,MIN(FechaCorte) AS min_target,MAX(FechaCorte) AS max_target FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja WHERE SistemaOrigen='MPRO' AND SucursalOrigenID IN ('0021','0023') GROUP BY SucursalOrigenID) tgt ON tgt.sucursal=src.sucursal ORDER BY src.sucursal;

queries.name: mpro_global_duplicate_identity_check
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS duplicate_groups FROM (SELECT ServerID,FolioCorte,COUNT_BIG(*) AS c FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja WHERE SistemaOrigen='MPRO' GROUP BY ServerID,FolioCorte HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) d;

queries.name: mpro_global_canonical_coverage
queries.sql: SELECT UnidadNegocioNombre,SucursalOrigenID,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows,MIN(FechaCorte) AS min_fecha,MAX(FechaCorte) AS max_fecha,MAX(FechaSincronizacion) AS last_sync_at FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja WHERE SistemaOrigen='MPRO' AND SucursalOrigenID IN ('0021','0023') GROUP BY UnidadNegocioNombre,SucursalOrigenID ORDER BY SucursalOrigenID;

queries.name: mpro_global_totals
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_cortes_mpro,COUNT(DISTINCT SucursalOrigenID) AS sucursales_mpro,MIN(FechaCorte) AS min_fecha_global,MAX(FechaCorte) AS max_fecha_global FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja WHERE SistemaOrigen='MPRO' AND SucursalOrigenID IN ('0021','0023');
